## Scope

Describe the behavioral or documentation change, and link the related issue if one exists.

## Verification

- [ ] Python contract tests pass: `python -m pytest tests -q`
- [ ] Frontend checks pass for modified modules
- [ ] Pages or local-runtime behavior verified, as applicable
- [ ] Official source URLs and observation dates included for opportunity/deadline changes

## Trust boundaries

- [ ] No API keys, private correspondence or local applicant state were committed
- [ ] Unverified claims remain explicitly labeled; no fabricated deadline, funding or eligibility status
- [ ] The change does not imply autonomous email, portal submission or authenticated public inference

## Release impact

List affected routes, configuration changes, migration needs, and whether `CHANGELOG.md` should be updated.
